original_test_intent: Sustain simultaneous network, storage, GPU and memory load for 12 hours at 40C/+5% rails, with all eight NIC paths above their approved 80%-of-ideal floors and no system degradation.
original_method: Map all devices/topology/peers and immutable scratch storage; pin drivers/tools/profiles; verify cooling/feed/client capacity and calibrate environment; preserve logs; start phase-gated bounded workloads then overlap for a documented 12-hour steady interval; capture per-NIC throughput/errors, FIO integrity/latency, GPU utilization/thermal/XID, memory coverage/ECC, system power/thermal/heartbeat; abort on subsystem limits; stop cleanly, verify data/health and restore network/environment.
manual_activity: Lab operator controls chamber/rails, cabling/client and concurrent workload lifecycle; subsystem owners approve destructive/performance scopes.
agent_execution_scope: No physical setup or PASS claim
